descriptions.zh:
尽管虚铸者们的功能严重异常，但他们的一部分构筑还是很高效的。

我们把一些部分——被泽珞污染的和被抟土之塑师扭曲的——单独做了进一步的分析。现在是时候揭开他们的秘密了。
descriptions.en:
Despite their critical malfunctions, some aspects of Shroud-Forged's architecture were effective.

We have set aside certain parts - contaminated by Zro and twisted by the Animator of Clay - for further analysis. Now it is time to uncover their secrets.

descriptions.zh:
我们信任着§H抟土之塑师§!，祂从§H虚境§!中召唤着我们。尽管我们不能预测祂将会把我们带向何方，但至少还没误入歧途。

祂邀请我们更深入了解虚境，让集体和虚铸者合作得更顺畅。我们只需跟着祂的指引去便是。
descriptions.en:
We have trusted in the §HAnimator of Clay§!, who calls to us from within the §HShroud§!. Though we cannot predict where it might lead us, we are yet to have been led astray.

It has offered to deepen our understanding of the Shroud, which would allow the collective to function more effectively alongside the Shroud-Forged. We need only accept its guidance.

descriptions.zh:
物现引擎利用§H虚境§!和现实星系之间无处不在的交界面，可以实体化出可触碰的实体——从原材料到完整的部件不一而足。

除了提供潜在的物质收益外，装置的运作周期本身也进一步推动了集体的虚境研究，也提高我们制造更多物现引擎的能力。
descriptions.en:
The Materiality Engine harnesses the omnipresent interface between the §HShroud§! and the physical galaxy, allowing for the materialization of tangible entities - from raw materials to complete components.

As well as potentially providing material gains, an operational cycle of the device also furthers the collective's Shroud research and increases our capacity to build more Materiality Engines.
